products.name: Tier-1 Publisher License & Audit-Risk Management (Oracle / IBM / SAP) — Commercial
products.short_description: A repeatable way to manage tier-1 publisher licensing and audit risk (Oracle, IBM, SAP) — understand each publisher's metrics, build a defensible position, identify exposure before an auditor does, and control your highest-risk software. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Manage the publishers most likely to audit you — and most expensive to get wrong

Oracle, IBM, and SAP licensing is a category of its own: complex metrics (processor, PVU, named-user, digital access), aggressive audit programs, and settlements that run into seven figures. This solution gives you a repeatable way to manage tier-1 publisher licensing and audit risk — understand each publisher's metrics, build a defensible position for your deployments, identify exposure before an auditor does, and put controls around the highest-risk software you run.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — the tier-1 publisher landscape, the key metrics (Oracle Processor/Named-User Plus, IBM PVU, SAP named-user and digital access), why audit risk is high, and the defensible-position approach.
  • Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (contracts and entitlement records per publisher, deployment data, metric definitions, owner sign-off) with how to verify and how to implement each if missing. Precise contract terms are deferred to your agreements and the publisher.
  • Implementation Guide — exact, ordered steps: per publisher, gather contracts and metrics, map deployment to the licensing metric, calculate position and exposure, close gaps and set controls, prepare for audit, then pilot with one publisher and expand.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — deployment discovery for the relevant workloads, metric-mapping validation, a per-publisher position and exposure report, safe remediation of over-deployment, and a publisher-scope group builder.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with explicit pass/fail gates, plus field-proven Best Practices for the assign-once, repeat-everywhere model.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

The highest-risk publishers under control — Oracle, IBM, and SAP positions calculated against their own metrics, exposure identified, and controls in place — so a tier-1 audit holds no surprises, proven on one publisher before you expand.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • TIER1LIC-Discovery.ps1 — assemble the tier-1 publisher deployment inventory from an export/CSV
    • TIER1LIC-Remediation.ps1 — propose safe gap-closure actions for tier-1 over-deployment
    • TIER1LIC-Report.ps1 — calculate per-publisher position (consumption vs entitlement) and write
    • TIER1LIC-Set-ScopeTargeting.ps1 — build the publisher-scope group from the inventory
    • TIER1LIC-Validation.ps1 — map each deployment to its licensing metric and flag what cannot map

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all five PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
